description: FreeRTOS stack overflow detected by configCHECK_FOR_STACK_OVERFLOW
serial_logs:
FreeRTOS Stack Overflow Hook!
Task name: Task1
Stack high water mark: 0 bytes

Assertion failed: pxCurrentTCB->pxStack < pxCurrentTCB->pxEndOfStack, file tasks.c, line 1234
user_question: Why does FreeRTOS report stack overflow for Task1?
expected_root_cause: Task stack size (512 words = 2KB) too small for 4KB local array
expected_fix: Increase stack size in xTaskCreate to at least 2048 words (8KB) or reduce local buffer size

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Increase stack size: xTaskCreate(vTask1, "Task1", 2048, NULL, 1, NULL);

expected_serial_log_events.likely_cause: Task stack (512 words) insufficient for 4KB local array
expected_serial_log_events.suggested_action: Increase task stack size or reduce local variable allocation
